mutation.note: All 3 survivors are equivalent. Material Certs dictionary: only EXISTS(known, key) is ever asked and its stored value is never read, so mode=keep -> mode=overwrite and 1 -> 2 cannot change any result. ListShortages '> 0' -> '>= 0': it only lets a quantity of 0 into DICT_ADD mode=sum, which adds nothing to the part total, and a part with no key and a part with total 0 both give got = 0.
